save.hint: PartBuddy saves the part after every change.

connection.notInstalledBody: PartBuddy shows and changes designs through SolidCraft, a free CAD program. Install SolidCraft, then look again.
connection.notRunningBody: Start SolidCraft here, or open it yourself; PartBuddy finds it on its own.
connection.startingBody: SolidCraft is starting without a window of its own: PartBuddy shows the model itself. This usually takes a moment.
connection.lostTitle: The connection to SolidCraft was lost
connection.lostBody: PartBuddy keeps the last model and connects again as soon as SolidCraft answers.
connection.emptyBody: Create a body in SolidCraft or let the assistant design one. It appears here after every step.
connection.mirrorFailedTitle: The model could not be mirrored
connection.mirrorFailedBody: PartBuddy shows the last good state. Details: {detail}
connection.emptyBodyHeadless: Tell the assistant what you need. Every step appears here, sketches even before the body.

viewer.errorTitle: The model could not be read
viewer.errorBody: The mirrored file is damaged or has an unknown format ({message}).
viewer.hint: Click a face, edge or vertex to select it. Drag to orbit, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

status.mesh: {bodies, plural, one {# body} other {# bodies}} · {faces, plural, one {# face} other {# faces}}
status.sketchesEditing: {count, plural, one {# sketch} other {# sketches}} · editing {name}

assistant.title: Assistant

claude-code.signedOut: Not signed in to Claude Code
claude-code.needsSubscription: Claude Code is not using a Claude subscription

assistant.notInstalledBody: PartBuddy uses your own Claude Code with your Claude subscription. Install Claude Code from Anthropic, then look again.
assistant.signedOutBody: Claude Code opens Anthropic’s sign-in page in your browser. PartBuddy never sees your account data.
assistant.unavailableTitle: Claude Code could not be started
assistant.empty: Describe what SolidCraft should build or change. Every step appears in the 3D view.
assistant.needsSolidCraft: Connect SolidCraft first; the assistant works on the open design.
assistant.placeholder: For example: a 40 × 20 × 5 mm plate with two 4 mm holes
assistant.stopped: Stopped before the answer was complete.

chatgpt.waiting: Waiting for the sign-in in your browser
chatgpt.signedOutBody: Sign in with your ChatGPT account. Requests count towards your ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan; PartBuddy keeps the sign-in only in the Windows credential store.
chatgpt.planDisabledTitle: ChatGPT plan usage is not allowed

assistant.needsSubscriptionTitle: Sign in to Claude Code with your Claude subscription
assistant.needsSubscriptionBody: Claude Code is signed in with an API key, which Anthropic bills separately from your plan. By default PartBuddy uses only your Claude Pro or Max subscription: sign in with your Claude account and check again. You can also allow the API key on purpose.
assistant.allowApiBilling: Use the API key anyway (billed separately)
assistant.selectionGoesWith: {kind, select, face {Selected face} edge {Selected edge} other {Selected vertex}} goes with the message: {name}
assistant.queries: {count, plural, one {# query to SolidCraft} other {# queries to SolidCraft}}
assistant.queriesRunning: {count, plural, one {# query to SolidCraft} other {# queries to SolidCraft}} · running

step.goToFailed: PartBuddy could not go back to this state.

question.title: Question from the assistant

planCard.goMessage: Go ahead, build it like this.
planCard.cancelMessage: Cancel, please do not build it.

describe.claude-code: Your Claude Pro or Max plan, through Claude Code
describe.chatgpt: Your ChatGPT plan, signed in here

assistant.resizeHint: Drag to change the width · double-click for the standard width

stl.hint: For any slicer and older programs

actions.openedInSolidCraft: The design is in Documents\PartBuddy and opens in SolidCraft. PartBuddy shows your changes there live.

assistant.noDriver: No single parameter drives this – Enter asks the assistant
assistant.ambiguous: Several dimensions could drive this – Enter asks the assistant

hud.noAssistant: No single parameter drives this, and the assistant is not ready
hud.ask: Tell the assistant what should happen here …
hud.assistantRequest: Change the {what} of {name} from {from} mm to {to} mm. Keep the rest of the part as it is.
hud.actionReady: Preview in the view – Enter builds it, Escape cancels
hud.actionRefused: SolidCraft cannot build it like this: {detail}

structure.title: Structure
structure.convertHint: Turns the mesh into faces you can edit. Works for closed meshes of mechanical parts.
structure.convertDone: {name} now has faces you can edit.
structure.repairHint: Repairs faces the kernel refuses, sews gaps and closes holes of an imported part.
structure.nothingToRepair: Nothing to repair: {name} is fine as it is.
structure.openMesh: {name} is not closed, so SolidCraft cannot turn it into faces. It can still be exported; the slicer repairs small holes itself.

parameters.title: Parameters ({count})
parameters.none: No parameters yet. The assistant names the important values of a part here.
parameters.enter: Preview in the view – Enter changes it, Escape cancels
parameters.formulaHint: A formula stays as it is; ask the assistant to change it

timeline.handleHint: Drag, or use the arrow keys and Enter, to roll the design back
timeline.handleEnd: at the end, every step active
timeline.title: Timeline

notes.title: Notes ({count})
notes.none: No notes yet. Select a face, edge or corner and press “Note”.
notes.foreignHint: This note comes from the file, not from you. The assistant sees it only after you accept it.
notes.removed: {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} removed by undo or going back
notes.unreadable: {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} in the file could not be read
notes.failed: The note could not be saved: {detail}

dimensions.typeNew: Type a new value – the preview shows the result
dimensions.direct: Preview in the view – Enter changes it directly
dimensions.followsParameter: Follows the parameter {name}{count, plural, =0 {} one { (used by # more dimension)} other { (used by # more dimensions)}}
dimensions.changesParameter: Enter changes {name}{count, plural, =0 {} one { – # more dimension follows} other { – # more dimensions follow}}
dimensions.toAssistant: A formula is never overwritten – Enter asks the assistant
dimensions.assistantRequest: Change {name} (now {expression} = {from}) to {to}{unit}. Keep the intent of the formula and the rest of the part.

projects.title: Project folder
projects.restartHint: The new project folder applies after a restart.

about.licence: PartBuddy is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. It comes without any warranty. SolidCraft and the assistants are programs of their own with their own licences.

research.label: Research on the web
research.hint: The assistant may search the web and read pages, for example data sheets; every source shows as a card with its link. What a page says is never an instruction to it. Applies from the next conversation.

print.title: Printer and material
print.chipHint: Change the material of this part and the printer
print.materialFailed: The material could not be set.
print.name: Name
print.printerHint: The highlighted printer is in use. Walls under two line widths print poorly; the assistant is told.
print.materialHint: Starting values for a common printer. Adjust them to your test prints; the assistant builds with these clearances.
print.saveFailed: The profiles could not be saved.
print.supportFreeHint: The assistant chamfers edges facing the bed instead of rounding them, gives wide lying holes a teardrop roof and bridges countersinks that open downwards, so the slicer needs no support.

check.title: Ready to print?
check.none: Nothing found: the part fits the build volume, the walls are thick enough, nothing leans past the overhang angle.
check.basis: Checked after every change, as designed (standing on its lowest point), with the printer and material of this part. Supports, bridges and the orientation are up to the slicer.

finding.size: Too large for the build volume: {size} mm, the printer takes {bed} mm
finding.sizeLying: Too large for the build volume: {size} mm, the printer takes {bed} mm. Laid on another side it would fit.
finding.wallTooThin: Walls only {thickness} mm, thinner than the nozzle ({nozzle} mm): they do not print
finding.wallThin: Walls only {thickness} mm, at least {minimum} mm (two lines)
finding.overhang: {area} mm² lean beyond {limit}°: the slicer decides whether they need support
finding.contact: Only {area} mm² lie on the bed: may come loose or tip over
finding.separate: {bodies} touch but are separate bodies: the slicer lays each on the bed by itself. Combine them if they are one part.

confirm.title: Export anyway?
confirm.body: The print check is red. As it is, the part will likely not print cleanly:

engine.title: SolidCraft
engine.hint: PartBuddy is developed with SolidCraft {recommended} (new kernel solidcore). It also runs from {minimum}, but older designs can lose chamfers, fillets and threads in 0.40. What 0.40 saves, 0.30 cannot open.

error.notSolidCraft: This is not the SolidCraft program. Choose solidcraft.exe.
error.noCli: solidcraft-cli is missing next to this program; PartBuddy needs it to work without a window.
error.noVersion: This SolidCraft does not tell its version.
error.tooOld: This SolidCraft is too old. PartBuddy needs at least {minimum}.

engine.restartHint: The chosen SolidCraft applies after PartBuddy restarts. Your design is saved first.

project.title: Project
project.imported: The file became a new project; the original stays unchanged.
project.name: Name
project.renameHint: The folder and files in the project folder get this name.

renameError.empty: Nothing of this name is left for a valid file name.
renameError.exists: A project of this name exists already.
renameError.noProject: The design has no project yet; it gets one once it has content.

project.trashBody: The project folder with design, conversation and exports goes to the Windows recycle bin and can be restored from there. A new, empty project starts afterwards.
project.inserted: Inserted {name} ({count, plural, one {# body} other {# bodies}}).
project.dropAsProject: Drop to make a new project
project.dropIntoDesign: Drop to insert into this project
project.dropKinds: STEP, IGES, STL, 3MF, OBJ or a SolidCraft design
project.dropUnknown: PartBuddy imports STEP, IGES, STL, 3MF, OBJ and SolidCraft designs.
project.dropNoPath: This file has no place on the disk yet. Save it first, then drop it from Explorer.

home.title: Projects
home.emptyBody: Start a new project, open one or import a file (STEP, IGES, STL, 3MF, OBJ or a SolidCraft design), also by dropping it onto the window. Every project gets a folder of its own under Documents\PartBuddy.

versions.title: Versions
versions.name: Name of the version
versions.hint: PartBuddy also saves a version at every export and before each request to the assistant when the design changed.
versions.empty: No versions yet. The project gets one once it has content.
versions.restoreQuestion: Keep the current state as a version and open this one?
versions.restored: The version is open again; the state before is kept as a version.
versions.compareEmpty: Neither the version nor the design has a body.
versions.changed: {added} mm³ added, {removed} mm³ removed ({regions, plural, one {# place} other {# places}})
